question: Does the independently frozen B24 numeric repeatability envelope generalize to 24 algorithmically selected, previously unused timeline frames while provenance and structure remain exact?

holdout.selectionRule: All timeline frames from 1 through 144 where frame mod 6 equals 4.

design.type: three fresh-process replicates per holdout frame with same-Render-Result dual output

validationGate.provenanceAndStructure: All 72 observations pass exact identity, source, plan, structure, control, process, call-count and format gates.
validationGate.EXR32_SCENE_LINEAR: All 72 holdout pairs satisfy all three frozen EXR numeric ceilings.
validationGate.PNG8_DISPLAY: All 72 holdout pairs satisfy all three frozen PNG numeric ceilings and zero Yee failure pixels.

decisionRule.PRODUCTION_REPEATABILITY_ENVELOPE_SUPPOR: Both EXR and PNG pass 72/72 holdout pairs and all provenance gates pass.
decisionRule.SCENE_LINEAR_ENVELOPE_FAIL_DISPLAY_PASS: EXR has one or more envelope failures while PNG passes 72/72, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.DISPLAY_AND_SCENE_LINEAR_ENVELOPE_FAIL: Both EXR and PNG have one or more envelope failures, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.DISPLAY_ONLY_ENVELOPE_FAIL: EXR passes 72/72 while PNG has one or more envelope failures, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any derivation, identity, source-state, process, call/save-count, layout, file, metric, binding, count or attack gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: holdout set or run order mismatch
save count differs from two or same-Render-Result contract fails
comparison loses manifest or file hash binding
explicitNonClaims: Passing validates this numeric envelope on one held-out scene/timeline profile; it does not establish a universal Blender tolerance.
The envelope is not a bitwise determinism claim and container hashes may differ.
The Yee auxiliary metric at 100 cd/m2 and 45 degrees is not a calibrated cinema or human blind-review result.
A display pass with an EXR fail does not make the scene-linear mastering difference irrelevant.
A holdout failure must remain published and thresholds must not be widened after observation.
Nothing generalizes to Cycles, another GPU/backend, another machine, another scene or temporal video perception.
